headline.title: The SOR window: pick a layout
headline.impact: Eight candidate layouts for the SOR window, switchable from a bar at the bottom of any SOR. Open the demo SOR, try them, and pick one. How an SOR works does not change.
changes: Staging only: open any SOR and use the Layout preview bar at the bottom of the window to try different layouts for the SOR window.
Pick one from the menu, use the arrows, or press Shift + Left/Right. Your pick is remembered for every SOR you open.
Nothing about how an SOR works changes; this is for comparing layouts before one is chosen.

headline.title: Revert to last stage; Resume or Start fresh
headline.impact: A move can be taken back one step, even from Closed Lost. Coming back to a Stage asks whether to pick up the earlier work or start again, and tasks from a Stage the SOR has left wait on hold instead of cluttering lists.
changes: New "Revert to last stage" on an SOR takes it back to the stage its last move came from, even with no path drawn back and even from Closed Lost. It's available to whoever made the move, the Deal Owner, or a Super Admin, and goes back one step only.

If no work was done on the stage being left, Revert simply undoes the move. If work was done, you choose Keep progress (it's saved for when the SOR comes back) or Remove progress (it's closed off but stays on the SOR's history).
Reverting out of the Won stage clears the Contract Date that move set, and anyone the move notified is told to disregard it.
Moving an SOR back to a stage it has been on before now asks: Resume previous work, or Start fresh.
Tasks from a stage the SOR has left go on hold and drop off everyone's list until the SOR returns. Operations can mark a Stage Action to carry on past its stage instead.

headline.title: Always sees: Everyone · Always edits · Legacy Pipeline open
headline.impact: Each Sales Flow says who always sees its SORs, now including Everyone, and who always edits them. Legacy Pipeline is open to everyone, as before Sales Flows; Government and Outright stay private.
changes: Always sees and Journey viewers can be set to Everyone, and the Flow Canvas shows it on every Stage's audience.
New Always edits list per flow: the people named there can edit every SOR of that Sale Type, the way the Deal Team can.
Legacy Pipeline's Always sees and Always edits are both Everyone, so the SORs registered before Sales Flows behave as they always did.
The SOR window asks the database whether you can edit, so the Edit button and what the database allows always agree.
Every employee can edit the Flow Canvas again; saving a Stage no longer fails with a database permission error.

headline.title: Settings in tabs, saved task filters
headline.impact: Settings is six tabs, and you only see the ones you can use. Leave categories moved into Settings. On Tasks, Save filters as default remembers every filter.
changes: Settings is split into tabs: General, Approval Rules, HR & Schedule, Sales Configuration, Employee Groups and System Announcements. You only see the tabs you can use.
Leave categories are managed in Settings, under HR & Schedule. HR Management has a card that takes you there.
Changing an approval rule takes effect in open approval queues straight away, with no page reload.
On Tasks, "Save filters as default" remembers every filter, not just SORS.
On Tasks and Group Tasks the button reads "Default saved" once saved, or "Update default" if the filters changed since.
Task windows lead with the title and description, then the task itself.
The Commission Pool card in Settings opens with the keyboard.

headline.title: One-row SORS header, floating Register button
headline.impact: Search and figures on the left, view tabs and Filters on the right, all on one row that no longer shifts when you switch views. Register SOR is a floating button at the bottom right.
changes: The SORS header is now a single row: search and results on the left, view tabs and Filters on the right, so switching views no longer moves them.
Search and the SOR count, Open and Won figures appear on List and Board only. Figures are shortened (e.g. ₱353.7M); hover for the exact amount.
The Filters button shows how many filters are on. On Overview and Deleted it stays in place, greyed out.
Register is now a floating button at the bottom-right, clear of the environment banner.
On phones, the view tabs and Filters show icons only.

headline.title: One consistent look
headline.impact: Pick-lists, form fields, tables, pop-ups and side panels look and behave the same on every screen, with keyboard support everywhere.
changes: Dropdown pickers, form fields, tables, pop-up windows and side panels now look and behave the same on every screen, so the app feels like one product instead of a mix of one-off designs.
Pick-lists that used the browser's plain dropdown (filters, page size, employee and offset forms) now use the app's own dropdown, with keyboard support, and still work inside the Filters menu.
Pop-up windows, the notifications panel and the mobile menu now open and close smoothly, and close the same way everywhere: press Escape or click outside.
Tables in SORS, Purchasing, HR, Offsets and Group Tasks share one look, and the login and reset-password buttons now match the rest of the app.
